name: BugReportToolkit
description: A zero-dependency Unity in-game bug reporter that captures screenshots, logs, and diagnostics into ZIP bundles or sends directly to webhooks.

name: SpreadsheetToScriptableObjects
description: A Unity tool that converts .CSV / .XLSX spreadsheet contents to ScriptableObjects.

name: UnityEventToolkit
description: An intuitive Unity editor tool for scanning, filtering, and cleaning up UnityEvents to keep event listeners organized and working efficiently.

name: SaveEncryptionToolkit
description: A flexible Unity save system toolkit that provides robust encryption and serialization utilities designed to plug into your own save manager.

name: ScriptableBatchTool
description: A Unity Editor Window tool designed to streamline the creation and management of multiple ScriptableObject instances.

name: DebugCommandSystem
description: An extendable Unity debug console integrated with the New Input System, featuring typed commands, auto-completion, and command suggestions.
